column3: “Writers who trouble” is rendered “those who constantly record unjust decisions.”
“Except anyone kneeled down” is rendered “Nothing remains but to crouch.”
Assyria is referred to as “it” rather than “him.”
“The Lord Yahweh of hosts” is rendered “the Lord, the GOD of hosts,” and “leanness” as “a wasting disease.”
“Orchard” is rendered “fruitful garden,” and “from soul and unto flesh” as “both soul and body.”
“A number” is rendered “so small in number.”
“In it” is rendered “within them,” and NASB adds “Only.”
“Because of fatness” is kept; the meaning is uncertain.
